Muramasa's efforts to hold it back must have reached their limit. Full paralysis did not seem far away.

en.html:
Ignoring Muramasa's hesitation, I began to run. My legs were like rods and could make little speed. Still, I hurried, one step upon another.

Soldiers' corpses lay here and there, as though marking a path. Had they been breadcrumbs, this might have been a fairy tale. They were flesh rank with death. Nothing but a familiar picture of hell.

I ran, tormented by foreboding.

村正の逡巡を無視して走り出す。
　棒のようになった足ではろくに速度が出なかったが、
それでも一歩に次ぐ一歩を急ぐ。

　道を示すように、兵士の骸が点々と在る。
　パン屑なら童話の一景色であろうが、屍臭濃い肉だ。
典型的な地獄絵図でしかない。

　悪しき予感に苛まれつつ、駆ける。

en.html:
<ruby>Lured<rt>Led</rt></ruby> onward by dead flesh, I found steel carcasses waiting.

Four regular Rokuhara dragoons. Every one... brought down by a single blow.

The work of a skilled warrior, beyond doubt.

Which meant that this temple had been attacked by the greatest military force on earth—the greatest possible danger.

And it had already—

Broken through every defense————

My body betrayed my will. It insisted that its strength was finished and would not move.

Shit.

What use was this body to me?

It could not do even this much—catch that enemy, drag them down, straddle them, and crush their face with my fists!?

Do it!

DO IT!!

I would gouge out this knight's heart as <ruby>payment<rt>atonement</rt></ruby> for killing my adoptive father.
